name: MongoDB 8 Replica Set (Prisma-Ready) with Backups
description: Single-node replica set for transactions and change streams, with backups.

upstream.mongodb: mongo:8.0.34-noble@sha256:3c64937121b9437095921c4bb2569911084c05f7b88e4a263d62a8959d2b2399 (MongoDB Community Server 8.0.34, Docker Official Image built 2026-10-26)
upstream.entrypoint: docker-library/mongo 8.0/docker-entrypoint.sh (identical to the file in the pinned image)
upstream.license: MongoDB Community Server: SSPL-1.0; Database Tools and mongosh: Apache-2.0; rclone: MIT

MONGOHOST.description: Private hostname of this database (mongodb.railway.internal), same as Railway's MongoDB.

MONGOPORT.description: MongoDB port (fixed: mongod always listens on 27017).

MONGOUSER.description: Root user name for clients and the Data panel.

MONGOPASSWORD.description: Root password for clients and the Data panel.

MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME.description: Root user created on the first boot (role root on admin). Changing it later does not rename the user.

MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Root password, generated at deploy (letters only, URL-safe). Set on the first boot only: change it with db.changeUserPassword() first, then here.

MONGO_REPLICA_SET_NAME.description: Replica set name (replicaSet= in connection strings). Fixed after the first boot.

MONGO_REPLICA_SET_KEY.description: keyFile content for internal replica-set authentication, written to a 0400 file at every boot. Not a client password.

MONGO_REPLICA_SET_HOST.description: Member host stored in the replica-set config; drivers connect to it. Kept in sync at boot if the private hostname changes.

MONGO_DATABASE.description: Application database used in DATABASE_URL (MongoDB creates it on the first write).

MONGO_URL.description: Private connection string (replica set, private network only). Other services reference it as MongoDB.MONGO_URL.

MONGO_PUBLIC_URL.description: Connection from outside Railway through the TCP proxy (directConnection=true; no TLS; egress is billed).

DATABASE_URL.description: Prisma-style URL with the database name (private network). Set your app's DATABASE_URL to a reference of it.

DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Prisma-style URL through the TCP proxy, e.g. for prisma db push from your machine.

MONGO_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: RAM the cache is planned for. auto = the container limit capped at 8192 MB; or a number of MB.

MONGO_CACHE_SIZE_GB.description: WiredTiger cache. auto = 50% of (memory budget - 1 GB), at least 0.25; or a number of GB (0.25-1024).

MONGO_OPLOG_SIZE_MB.description: Oplog size. auto = 5% of the volume (128-2048 MB) when first created; a number >= 990 also resizes an existing oplog.

MONGO_SELF_RESOLVE.description: hosts = map the member host to 127.0.0.1 inside this container so mongod finds itself at boot; dns = wait for Railway DNS.

MONGO_RSEQ_WORKAROUND.description: auto = disable TCMalloc per-CPU caches on Linux 6.19.0-7.0.13, where mongod 8.0.34 refuses to start (SERVER-121912); on/off.

MONGO_FTDC_ENABLED.description: Full-time diagnostic data capture into the volume (false, as in Railway's MongoDB). true when MongoDB support asks for it.

MONGOD_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Extra mongod flags, space-separated (e.g. --setParameter notablescan=1). Do not repeat flags the wrapper sets.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy, so mongod checkpoints and shuts down cleanly.

MONGO_URL.description: Private replica-set URL of the database (root user; needed for --oplog and full dumps).

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Keep false: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style URLs. true only for buckets whose Credentials tab says path-style.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/mongodb.archive.gz and MANIFEST.txt.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_OPLOG.description: true = mongodump --oplog (point-in-time consistent dump). false if --db/--query filters are added below.

BACKUP_VERIFY.description: full = re-read the whole archive (gzip check) and its header; quick = header only (mongorestore --dryRun).

BACKUP_ATTEMPTS.description: mongodump attempts per run (--oplog fails if a collection is renamed during the dump).

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for a writable primary before failing.

BACKUP_RESTORE_RUN.description: One-shot restore: a run folder (e.g. 20261031T031500Z) restored into MONGO_URL on the next run. Clear it afterwards.

BACKUP_RESTORE_USERS.description: true = a restore also replaces users and roles (the root password then becomes the archived one).
